data.notes: February 2027 confirmations are still sparse, but verified standouts include Southern hip-hop, arena R&B, local DJ nightlife, and a major 1980s music cruise departing New Orleans.

events.title: The 80s Cruise 2027
events.venueName: Royal Caribbean’s Mariner of the Seas
events.summary: The 80s Cruise sails from New Orleans with a lineup including Chaka Khan, Night Ranger, Loverboy, DMC, Peter Hook & The Light, Public Image Ltd. and DJ Jazzy Jeff. The official cruise site confirms the February 27–March 6, 2027 itinerary departing New Orleans.

events.title: Mardi Gras Day 2027: Black Masking / Mardi Gras Indians
events.summary: Citywide Mardi Gras Day masking by New Orleans Black Masking Indian tribes, centered on Uptown, Downtown, and Westbank neighborhood traditions—one of the city’s defining African-diaspora Carnival expressions.

events.title: The Love of Soul Tour: Fantasia, Anthony Hamilton, October London
events.summary: Fantasia brings The Love of Soul Tour to Smoothie King Center with Anthony Hamilton and October London. The venue confirms the New Orleans stop for February 19, 2027 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: 8Ball & MJG and Bun B ft. The Renaissance Orchestra
events.summary: Southern hip-hop legends 8Ball & MJG and Bun B perform at the Saenger Theatre with the Renaissance Orchestra. The official listing confirms the Saturday, February 13, 2027 show at 8:00 PM CT.

events.title: La Reezy presents: SKIDDLE BANDANA Tour
events.summary: La Reezy’s SKIDDLE BANDANA Tour is listed for Gasa Gasa on February 20, 2027 at 9:00 PM. The show is a confirmed hip-hop/rap club-size booking on Ticketmaster’s Gasa Gasa venue calendar.

events.title: The New Orleans High Society Hour: An Evening of Live Jazz and Burlesque
events.summary: Recurring AllWays Lounge cabaret night pairing the New Orleans High Society Jazz Band with burlesque and touring guests; a solid local jazz-cabaret scene pick during Carnival weekend.

events.title: 80's Night w/ Retro DJ Travis Bell
events.summary: Retro DJ Travis Bell hosts an 80s-themed dance night at The Howlin' Wolf. TicketWeb confirms the event for Friday, February 26, 2027 at 8:00 PM CST.

events.title: Krewe of Zulu Parade
events.summary: The historic African American Zulu Social Aid & Pleasure Club’s Mardi Gras morning parade, famous for hand-decorated coconuts and brass-band Carnival energy, is confirmed on the 2027 schedule for Tuesday, February 9 at 8:00 AM.

events.title: Krewe of NOMTOC Parade
events.summary: The New Orleans Most Talked Of Club’s Westbank parade is a major local social-aid Carnival fixture with floats, bands, marching units, and signature community throws, confirmed for Saturday, February 6 at 10:45 AM.

events.title: Krewe of Nandi Parade
events.summary: An all-female Westbank Carnival krewe named for Queen Nandi kaBhebe of the Zulu Nation, listed on the 2027 Mardi Gras schedule for Wednesday, February 3 at 6:00 PM.

events.title: The Mystic Krewe of Music Parade
events.summary: A newer Westbank Carnival krewe built explicitly around music themes, listed on the 2027 Mardi Gras schedule for Monday, February 1 at 6:00 PM.

events.title: New Orleans Friends of Music: Goldmund String Quartet
events.summary: New Orleans Friends of Music lists Goldmund String Quartet on Wednesday, February 24, 2027 at 7:30pm CST as part of its 2026–27 chamber-music season. The performance is scheduled for Dixon Hall on Tulane University’s uptown campus.
